name: OKC_XPRT_QUESTIONS_B
description: This entity stores the user questions, constants and expert variables.

columns.name: QUESTION_ID
columns.description: This is the primary column for the questions and constants table and is sequence generated.

columns.name: QUESTION_CODE
columns.description: QUESTION_CODE

columns.name: CONDITION_EXPR_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the conditions on the questions are 'Any True' or 'All True'. Possible values are 'ALL' or 'ANY'. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_CONDITION_EXPRESSION.

columns.name: QUESTION_TYPE
columns.description: This indicates the question type. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_QUESTION_TYPE. Possible values are Q and C. Q: Question, C: Constant.

columns.name: QUESTION_INTENT
columns.description: Intent of Question or Constant. B: Buy, S: Sell.

columns.name: DISABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the question or constant is disabled

columns.name: QUESTION_DATATYPE
columns.description: Indicates response datatype. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_QUESTION_DATATYPE. B: Boolean, N: Numeric, L: List of values.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_NAME
columns.description: The value set corresponding to the question with response type of List of Values. FK to FND value set.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: Value for Questions/Constants. Question value can be a Value id in case of Value set based Questions or Numeric value in case of Numeric Questions. This is mandatory when defining constants.

columns.name: MINIMUM_VALUE
columns.description: Not currently used. For a future release

columns.name: MAXIMUM_VALUE
columns.description: Not currently used. For a future release

columns.name: QUESTION_SYNC_FLAG
columns.description: This will be used to indicate if a question needs to be synchronized with Oracle Confiugrator

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: MODULE
columns.description: MODULE

columns.name: HEIGHT
columns.description: HEIGHT

columns.name: WIDTH
columns.description: WIDTH

columns.name: CONDITIONAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the Question is conditional. Possible values are 'Y', 'N'.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: VARIABLE_CODE
